verdict.rationale: Daytona documents arbitrary command execution in sandboxes through the SDK (`sandbox.process.exec`), a browser web terminal, and SSH access. Package installation is supported via Dockerfile-defined images built into snapshots, and snapshots persist installed packages and dependencies. Each sandbox has its own dedicated kernel and filesystem. Missing for 10: an explicit documented example of installing packages at runtime (e.g. pip/apt inside a running sandbox), and independent hands-on corroboration of the sandbox exec path.
